description: What the home page highlights for a region: a state, province, country or city. An operator's choice when there is one; otherwise the league the country governs (England's, Mexico's), or else the most popular clubs whose venue is in the region. Fails as not found when the region has none, and the home page shows as it always does.
name: get_highlight

curated.description: Whether an operator chose it, rather than the clubs' venues.

kind.description: league for one league's clubs, or teams for clubs across leagues.

league.description: The league's code, for a league highlight; null otherwise.

name.description: The region as the page says it, such as New York.

teams.description: The clubs, in the order to show them; a league highlight lists none, as the league is its clubs.

title: Regional highlight
